notes:
v4.6.39 — IBKR bots now actually run on IBKR (never silently on the Alpaca cloud)

🐛 FIXED — an 'IBKR' bot was still trading Alpaca
• Bots flagged 'Run on Oracle' execute on the cloud server, which is Alpaca-only and can't reach your local TWS/Gateway. So a bot you switched to IBKR kept running on Oracle against Alpaca — even after restarting it.
• In IBKR mode, bots now ALWAYS run locally (the 'Run on Oracle' toggle is ignored), so they connect to your TWS/Gateway and trade your IBKR sub-portfolio.
• On startup in IBKR mode, APEX now finds any stray Alpaca cloud instance still running on Oracle and STOPS it automatically — so it can't keep trading behind your back. You'll see a message; just press ▶ to run the bot locally on IBKR.

Reminder for IBKR: keep TWS (or IB Gateway) open and logged in while your bots run — that's where the trades go. Cloud 24/7 running is Alpaca-only.

Update normally via the in-app banner.
